primary_result: R11 completes the preregistered two-fold OOF regional action-observability screen and fails decisively. With the exact leakage-ineligible R10 per-image/equal-area action budget held fixed, the local candidate-context probe reaches a worse-operator mean gain of 0.0884324946 dB (grouped-bootstrap LCB95 0.0698162491) and retains 0.3701027959 of the R10 regional oracle (LCB95 0.2998807308). Those absolute gates pass, but the candidate-response representation adds no specific value: primary-minus-pooled is -0.0028996623 dB (LCB95 -0.0118461957), primary-minus-spatial-shuffle is -0.0002767182 dB (LCB95 -0.0089386885), and primary-minus-generic-state is -0.0109543898 dB (LCB95 -0.0190560738). The primary also trails the dual-operator-safe whole-image oracle by 0.0625368741 dB, has primary-minus-global CVaR5 -0.2453879144 dB, and produces 9 severe and 2 hard image events. The frozen local candidate-response representation/readout is therefore not a safe or incrementally informative regional observability mechanism under this contract; no continuation is authorized.
gate_reasons: All structural gates pass: exact R10 terminal and gate identities, 384 clean-image groups, 768 paired operator units, 49,152 tile/action rows, exact target and no-op replay, exact tile partition, clean-image OOF disjointness, finite metrics, valid training dynamics, exact R10 oracle/fold/action-distribution replay and untouched protected roles.

The R10 oracle reproduces exactly at worse-operator gain 0.2389403580740129 dB, mixed fraction 0.90625, bidirectional fraction 0.765625, tile counts 10,206 no-op / 9,055 positive / 5,315 negative, zero local materiality violations and zero fold-metric mismatches. R10 remains valid and unchanged.

The primary absolute gain gate passes: worse-operator gain is 0.0884324945844307 dB with LCB95 0.06981624912273575 dB. Oracle retention also passes at 0.3701027959330266 with LCB95 0.2998807307567878.

All representation-specific increment gates fail. Primary-minus-pooled is -0.002899662270027928 dB with LCB95 -0.011846195712452354; primary-minus-shuffle is -0.0002767181593677781 dB with LCB95 -0.00893868847603392; primary-minus-generic is -0.010954389798574299 dB with LCB95 -0.019056073784654452.

The generic local-state control is strongest at worse-operator mean gain 0.09938036283865044 dB, followed by pooled candidate response at 0.09093677110237315 dB, the primary at 0.0884324945844307 dB and spatial shuffle at 0.08838945789055952 dB. Thus positive absolute gain cannot be attributed to aligned local candidate response.
The primary is materially inferior to the dual-operator-safe whole-image oracle: primary-minus-global is -0.0625368741160323 dB with UCB95 -0.049623454109369004, decisively below the +0.005 dB line.
Tail safety fails strongly. Primary-minus-global CVaR5 is -0.2453879143528866 dB with UCB95 -0.16900776964763634, and the primary creates 9 severe and 2 hard image events.

Both folds fail the material increment contract. Fold 0 primary gain is 0.09133028111008185 dB but it loses to generic state by 0.014852163861341403 dB, shuffle by 0.0033170519244751645 dB and safe global by 0.07509748828263452 dB. Fold 1 primary gain is 0.08553470805877957 dB but it loses to generic state by 0.007064227412306265 dB, pooled response by 0.0062297080312858355 dB and safe global by 0.04997625994943013 dB.

Seed stability and cross-operator consistency pass: all fold-by-seed gains are positive, pooled seed gains are 0.09381024008097594 and 0.08272102518131096 dB, their range is below 0.020 dB, and D_ref/D_rep primary image gains correlate at 0.9998387260704485. The failure is not explained by one random seed or operator disagreement.

Every one of the 16 fitted diagnostic probes has finite decreasing full-fold training loss. No restoration model was trained or inferred, no candidate was regenerated, no checkpoint was loaded, and confirmation, canary and locked test were untouched.
competing_explanation: The preferred R11 mechanism was that aligned local candidate-response neighborhoods expose signed regional utility beyond image-level response summaries, spatially shuffled response and generic local state. The evidence rejects that mechanism for the frozen representation/readout: the aligned primary is statistically no better than pooled or shuffled response and is decisively worse than generic local state. The positive absolute gain and 37% oracle retention are therefore compatible with the leakage-ineligible R10 action budget plus generic state/coordinate ranking, not evidence that candidate-conditioned local response is specifically observable. R10 still proves that target-selected regional heterogeneity exists; R11 shows that this fixed deployable feature contract does not safely recover it.
limitations: R11 is a development-screening mechanism probe on the same 384 Haze4K development images used by R5-R10. It is not confirmation, external validation or a restoration-model experiment.

The R10 per-image and equal-area action counts are privileged outcome-derived budgets. They deliberately isolate placement/direction ranking and make every R11 replay nondeployable; the observed absolute gains cannot authorize a real policy.

The FAIL applies to the frozen 3x3 local candidate-response/state statistics, four matched cells, 303-to-64-to-2 MLP, seeds, folds, training budget and exact-budget assignment. It does not prove that all possible regional information sources are unobservable.

Because R11 authorizes NONE, it forbids neighbor search over features, grids, context sizes, heads, widths, depths, seeds, epochs, losses, thresholds, budgets, coverage rates or post-hoc subgroups on this reused population. A future proposal would require genuinely new information and independent authorization.
The calibration table is descriptive. It shows substantial eligibility uncertainty outside the highest score bin but cannot rescue the preregistered replay, control or tail gates.
No fog-severity, protected-region or semantic labels were used, so R11 cannot attribute its severe/hard failures to light fog, heavy fog, sky, highlight, texture or other named regions.
R5-R10 terminal decisions remain unchanged. Confirmation identities/outcomes, canary and locked test remain inaccessible.
